newsitem.title: USA: Intel sees April price move like February.
newsitem.headline: Intel sees April price move like February.

text.p: Intel Corp on Monday said its next regularly scheduled price reductions, due at the end of April, would be about the same as price cuts made in February.
"The price move is about equal to that last February," one Intel executive said in a conference call with analysts and reporters after the release of its first-quarter results.

Securities analysts at the time said the February price cuts were less than had been expected, interpreting that as a sign of solid demand for Intel chips. The February price moves ranged from no change to cuts of up to 34 percent.
